description: What the user settled, per turn (BUILD-PLAN F55).

items.description: What the user settled in these turns, as few items as say it.

turn.description: The label of the turn the item comes from, such as #3.

label.description: What kind of settled thing it is.

statement.description: One plain sentence saying what was settled, with no words the user did not use for names and numbers.

quote.description: The user's exact words that settle it, copied from the turn's USER text.

scope.description: global only for a preference or environment fact that holds for every project

term.description: long or short; short when unsure

proposal.description: For a decision that approves a proposal in BEFORE: the exact words of BEFORE that state what was proposed; otherwise empty.
